text: 香港交易所发文称，一只以以人民币计价、挂钩人民币货币基金(82800.HK)的衍生权证今日上市。这是时隔约十年，人民币衍生权证再度亮相香港市场，为投资者带来更多人民币产品选择。该权证目前是香港市场上唯一一只以人民币计价的衍生权证。
text_en: HKEX said in a statement that a derivative warrant denominated in RMB and linked to an RMB money market fund (82800.HK) listed today. This marks the return of RMB derivative warrants to the Hong Kong market after about a decade, giving investors more RMB product choices. The warrant is currently the only RMB-denominated derivative warrant in the Hong Kong market.
